cleanEntrances.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: registered clean background plates for a pixel-art animation, NOT a redesign.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a two-panel atlas, left is the shrine entrance, right is the torii entrance. Preserve the exact two equally sized square panels, original camera, geometry, every pixel-scale feature and both panel positions. Return the same 2:1 atlas layout.
Change ONLY the hanging golden bell and the two hanging white zigzag paper streamers in EACH panel (six objects total): REMOVE those objects, carefully reconstructing the exact wood/stone/door/foliage background behind them. Keep the thick braided sacred rope UNCHANGED, with the same shape, texture, golden lighting and position. Keep the little attachment points at the rope. Do not remove white architectural window panes or hanging foliage. No new objects, no text, no border, no rearrangement, no relighting, no blur. Match the reference's detailed illustrated pixel-art texture. The two cleaned close-ups will be precisely overlaid beneath the original moving bells and paper, so preserve registration aggressively.

mapleSprites.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for the illustrated pixel-art shrine animation.
Input image 1 is STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY: fine textured illustrated pixel art, autumn daytime Japanese shrine, warm vermilion red/orange maple leaves, dark fine woody twigs. Do not reproduce its architecture or characters.
Create a wide transparent-background sheet with THREE EQUAL COLUMNS, one row, with generous fully transparent gutters; no grid lines or lettering.
Column 1: one intact connected Japanese maple bough entering from the bottom LEFT, thin dark woody branch extending diagonally up and right, a rich but airy cluster of red and burnt-orange five/seven-point maple leaves. Visible spaces between leaf groups, finer secondary twigs, all leaves attached. Root at lower left, canopy above/right. The whole bough fits its cell with transparent padding.
Column 2: a DIFFERENT intact connected maple bough, similar root lower left, more arched and broad, vermilion and orange leaves with subtle golden tips, rich but airy. No tree trunk, no ground, no scenery.
Column 3: exactly THREE SEPARATE SINGLE maple leaves vertically arranged top/middle/bottom with large transparent gaps; a red leaf at top, orange-red leaf at middle, golden-orange leaf at bottom. Each is five/seven-point with a short stem, drawn at the same fine pixel-art texture and perspective as leaves on the branches. These will fly separately in the breeze.
Lighting: soft natural daytime, no glow. Exact style: high quality fine illustrated pixel art, crisp small color clusters, restrained painterly texture compatible with the reference, not smooth vector/anime, not chunky voxel. True transparent RGBA background, no cast shadows, no backing or halo, no labels. Keep every sprite whole and separated within its column. Landscape 3:2 or 2:1 canvas, no cropping.
